comparator: CGI (Cancer Genome Interpreter), cancergenomeinterpreter.org / Barcelona Biomedical Genomics Lab (BBGLab)
summary: CGI could NOT be run on the Horak-70 variants in this environment. Every machine-accessible path to obtain CGI's own per-variant calls is gated behind an email-registration authentication token (REST API) or an interactive/registered web session that cannot be reliably driven without reverse-engineering a non-public, unstable form protocol. No precomputed CGI prediction table for these variants was found. Per the anti-fabrication contract, no CGI classifications were assigned. CGI is therefore kept out of the head-to-head (same honest scoping as the OncoVI/CancerVar pair, which DID run).

paths_evaluated.detail: The current cancergenomeinterpreter.org is a static SPA (rebuilt 2026-04-23). It states the CGI tool 'is operated on a separate platform (platform.cgiclinics.eu)' and offers 'Register for CGI Open' requiring a university/institutional email address. Account registration required; no anonymous machine path.

Live and accepting GET/POST/DELETE, but enforces auth. GET with no auth -> HTTP 400 {"error_code":400,"message":"Missing user email or token. Please sign up in the method website and request a token"}. GET with a fabricated 'email token' header -> HTTP 404 {"error_code":404,"message":"User not found. Please register in our website"}. The docs (raw/legacy_rest_api_docs.html) state: 'To be able to use this feature you need to register in our website and request an authentication token.' No token is available in this environment (no CGI/BBGLab env var set).

paths_evaluated.path: Legacy CGI anonymous web submission: POST /2021/analysis/submit
paths_evaluated.detail: The legacy /2021/analysis page exposes a multipart form (fields: alterations, files x4, cancertype, title, reference) and an anonymous() JS path. Direct POSTs (urlencoded; multipart with/without empty file slots; with session cookie + Referer) all return CherryPy HTTP 400 'Bad request syntax or unsupported method' at the protocol layer. Driving this would require reverse-engineering the exact CherryPy multipart expectation and job-polling flow -- an unsanctioned, unstable interface; declined per anti-fabrication / honest-scoping policy rather than guess a protocol.

paths_evaluated.path: Precomputed CGI catalog / published prediction table for Horak-70
paths_evaluated.detail: Legacy /2021/download and /2021/data return 404/empty. The SPA links github.com/bbglab/cgi-pipeline (HTTP 404 / not public) and a downloads section that does not expose a variant-level prediction catalog for these specific variants. No official CGI prediction table covering the Horak-70 set was located.

axis_analysis.what_cgi_outputs: CGI annotates each alteration on (1) a DRIVER / oncogenicity axis -- 'known' oncogenic mutations (from prior knowledge / Catalog of Validated Oncogenic Mutations) and 'predicted' drivers (OncodriveMUT / BoostDM) vs predicted passengers -- and (2) a separate ACTIONABILITY axis (biomarkers of drug response from the Cancer Biomarkers Database). The site tagline is 'Identification of therapeutically actionable genomic alterations in tumors.'
axis_analysis.axis_verdict: If run, the correct comparison would be NEAR-AXIS: map CGI's driver/oncogenicity field (known oncogenic / predicted driver -> ONC; predicted passenger / non-protein-affecting -> BEN; unknown -> VUS) onto the VICC 3-class oncogenicity gold. This is closer to our engine's native axis than CancerVar (which is cross-axis, AMP/ASCO/CAP actionability). NOTE: CGI's driver taxonomy is still NOT identical to VICC oncogenicity (driver != VICC Oncogenic/Likely Oncogenic point system), so even near-axis it requires the documented mapping above and a stated caveat.

intended_mapping_if_unblocked.source_field: CGI per-mutation oncogenicity/driver classification (Oncogenic Summary / driver_statement, e.g. 'known' | 'predicted driver' | 'predicted passenger' | 'non-protein-affecting')
intended_mapping_if_unblocked.status: NOT APPLIED -- no CGI outputs were obtained; this mapping is documented only for the future unblocked run.

what_is_needed_to_unblock: A CGI authentication token (register an email at the legacy CGI site / cgiclinics platform and request a token), supplied to this environment as an env var (e.g. CGI_EMAIL + CGI_TOKEN, names only). With that, scripts/fetch_cgi.py would POST the Horak-70 (hg38 coordinates, alterations format) to /2021/api/v1, poll the job, parse per-variant driver calls, archive raw JSON under data/benchmark/cgi/raw/, and run_cgi_headtohead.py would score it exactly like cancervar_headtohead.json.
